body: ICMR-NIN counts more than 25 g of sugar a day as high, and lists sucrose (table sugar), jaggery, honey, glucose, fructose and dextrose as added sugars.
WHO recommends that adults and children keep free sugars below 10% of daily energy, and says below 5%, about 25 g a day, would bring further benefits.
